question: Will the US avoid striking Iran through November 3, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if the United States carries out no air strike or surface-to-surface missile strike that impacts Iran's territory through November 3, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern. Intercepted munitions, naval gunfire, cyber attacks and ground raids do not count. Same rules as the Polymarket market.

history.rationale: starting at market, will adjust. Calibration-adjusted reading of the same price is 85.4%.
10/27/2026 update to the market price 90.5%. No independent news view.

resolution.post_mortem: Resolved yes. Our last number was 90.5%; the market's last saved price before archival was 89.00%. Brier 0.009. Ceasefire held through the Nov 3 midterms: no US strike; de-escalation and deal momentum reported through Nov 5 (Brent fell from $105 to the mid-90s; no resumption of strikes). Market last traded 0.89 on Nov 2 before archival, prior to the midterms ending.
